reporting-org.narrative: United Nations Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees in the Near East

title.narrative: 2026 oPt Emergency Appeal - West Bank - Coordination and Management

description.narrative: As humanitarian needs continue to evolve in the West Bank, UNRWA will maintain its key role in the coordination architecture, including through co-leadership of key clusters, active engagement in the Humanitarian Country Team and cluster system, and co-chairing of the Area-Based Coordination Hub for the northern West Bank. The Agency will continue to facilitate local coordination among operational partners and maintain the internally displaced persons registration platform. It will also sustain reporting capacity to ensure timely and transparent communication with donors, clusters and other stakeholders, fostering accountability and enabling informed decision-making. UNRWA will strengthen security, operational and logistical support to ensure safe, efficient field operations and continuity of services in high-risk environments.
